title: Forget Boston, Retire To This Top-Rated East Coast Escape With Beautiful Beaches, Shops, And Historic Charm - NewsBreak
text:
By Sara Caskey ,
1 days ago In Boston, Massachusetts' historic capital city, there's no shortage of things to discover post-retirement. Its 2.5-mile Freedom Trail, for instance, which passes 16 significant sites, is like browsing through the pages of a history textbook in real life. There's also an ongoing calendar of activities at the Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum, and a highly-ranked network of hospitals. In other words, amenities someone in their golden years might hope for ... Despite Boston's countless benefits, however, it's grown notoriously expensive — and prices, especially for key things such as housing, are climbing. That's why considering more affordable East Coast escapes such as the nearby town of North Kingstown, Rhode Island, might be better for you and your wallet. Read full article
